jobs.title: Adjunct - Biological Sciences Laboratory Instructor
jobs.description: Sign InCreate ProfileEnglish (US)Adjunct - Biological Sciences Laboratory InstructorUnited States|req1585Posted on: 4/22/2021 Back to SearchAdjunct - Biological Sciences Laboratory Instructor Biola University invites applications for an adjunct faculty position in the Department of Biological Sciences. Responsibilities:-Teach laboratory sections in General Biology, Microbiology, Anatomy, Physiology, Genetics and Cell Biology, including: working with staff and student workers on the preparation of laboratory reagents, assessment of student work (homework, quizzes, laboratory notebooks) and evaluation of student techniques. Qualifications: Bachelors, Masters or terminal degree in Biology or related field. Experience in college level instruction is preferred. Commitment to high-quality instruction in a student-centered conservative Christian environment is required. Biola is an evangelical Christian university in which faculty endorse the University Doctrinal Statement, adhere to the Standard of Conduct, and are committed to integration of faith and learning. Faculty endorse a university-wide statement of Christian faith and community values. Personal commitment to the Christian faith is required. Apply by submitting a letter of interest, a curriculum vitae, and a one-page testimony of your faith to www.biola.edu/employment (see “create a profile”). After review by the department chair, promising candidates will be contacted and sent a faculty application form. Hours Per Week: 22.5Months Per Year: 4Hiring Range: Adjunct per unit rate ranges from $1,260/unit - $1,785/unit
